title: Turing Patterns for Multimedia: Reaction-Diffusion Multi-Modal Fusion for Language-Guided Video Moment Retrieval

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

background_setup.summary: # Introduction The rapid proliferation of multimedia content, encompassing videos, text, audio, and other modalities, has spurred significant advancements in multimodal and video-language representation learning .

evidence.quote: # Introduction The rapid proliferation of multimedia content, encompassing videos, text, audio, and other modalities, has spurred significant advancements in multimodal and video-language representation learning [36, 40, 53, 70].

background_setup.summary: These models aim to bridge the semantic gap between visual and textual data, enabling tasks such as moment retrieval and highlight detection .

evidence.quote: These models aim to bridge the semantic gap between visual and textual data, enabling tasks such as moment retrieval [34, 40, 41, 75] and highlight detection [40, 50, 51].

prior_work_summary.summary: Moment retrieval involves identifying specific temporal segments in a video that correspond to a textual query, while highlight detection seeks to pinpoint salient moments that capture the essence of the video content .

evidence.quote: Moment retrieval involves identifying specific temporal segments in a video that correspond to a textual query, while highlight detection seeks to pinpoint salient moments that capture the essence of the video content [40].
